name: Mock Interview Engine
_comment_depends_on: Nothing here is required to START, and nothing is marked required: true.
M06 is the front door: a student who opened a session must be able to finish
it whichever of these is down. Each one narrows what the session can do and
the report says which; none of them ends the interview.
`on_missing` is shown to a student: write a sentence they can act on.
Override any base_url without editing this file: M05_BASE_URL=http://...

depends_on.name: JD Parser & Coverage Planner
depends_on.reason: the coverage plan a session is built on, and the coverage ledger M06 writes asked / answered / skipped to
depends_on.on_missing: This session isn't tailored to a job description - the planner is offline, so the rounds are an even split of what the question bank can cover.

depends_on.name: Skill Graph & MNEMOS Memory
depends_on.reason: the session-pinned profile summary, the posterior that seeds question selection, and consent
depends_on.on_missing: I don't have your history this time, so the interview starts from the beginning and won't update your skill graph.

depends_on.name: Question Intelligence
depends_on.reason: the next question, its hints and follow-ups, and the in-session ability estimate it owns
depends_on.on_missing: Questions come from a short fixed set today, and this session won't be scored.

depends_on.name: Evaluation Engine
depends_on.reason: scores each answered turn against the rubric M05's selection names - asynchronously, never on the conversation's path
depends_on.on_missing: Your answers are saved and will be scored when the evaluator is back. The interview itself is unaffected.

depends_on.name: Resume Ingestion
depends_on.reason: your project claims for the project round; M01 is also the door defend drills come through
depends_on.on_missing: There's no project round this time - I can't read your resume right now.

_comment_feeds: These consume M06. They are NOT dependencies - M06 never blocks on them.
The drill response and the ledger rows are contracts other modules already
read; additive changes are safe, renaming or removing a field breaks them.

feeds.takes: one evaluation request per answered turn, from an outbox
coverage ledger rows: asked, answered, skipped
a ProvisionalOutcome per strategist verdict; the session's seen items
recent sessions for the profile summary
the session id and URL for a defend drill
break depths per concept, per session
the session event log: transcript, plan, re-plans, pacing
